description:
Remove one of this shop's webhook endpoints, for example one you no longer run or whose secret may have leaked. eno stops sending it events at once.

It cannot be undone: registering the address again gives a new id and a new secret. To change which events an endpoint gets, register it again with the new list, then delete the old one. A second call for the same id changes nothing more and answers `not_found`.

Returns the removed webhook's `id`.

id.description: The webhook to remove: its id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`), from list_webhooks or register_webhook

name: delete_webhook

id.description: The webhook that was removed, as you passed it; eno sends it no more events

title: Delete webhook
